item.title: Band’s Christmas Eve tradition brings music, joy to Indianapolis area
item.description: The Indy Christmas Caroling Big Band is a family-run tradition of spreading holiday cheer through music to those in need on Christmas Eve.

item.title: Mild and damp Christmas then a warmer weekend | Dec. 25, 2025
item.description: Christmas morning will be foggy and cloudy with temperatures in the lower 50s, followed by a mild weekend with patchy fog and rain, and a sharp cooldown on Sunday night with a chance of snow.

item.title: Pope Leo XIV urges the faithful on Christmas to shed indifference in the face of suffering
item.description: Pope Leo XIV, in his first Christmas Day message, urged the faithful to shed indifference towards those who have suffered from war, poverty, and migration, and to strive for peace through dialogue and solidarity.

item.title: At least 1 killed in crash near Mitthoefer Road, 38th Street
item.description: A fatal accident on Indianapolis' far east side has left at least one person dead, according to the Indianapolis Metropolitan Police Department.

item.title: Asian Harbor serves families’ holiday tradition: Chinese food for Christmas
item.description: Asian Harbor, an Indianapolis restaurant owned by Mongolian immigrants, has become a Christmas Eve and Christmas Day tradition for many families, providing a sense of community and cultural enrichment.

item.title: Ken Nunn, prominent personal injury lawyer based in Indiana, dies at 85
item.description: Ken Nunn, a prominent attorney and the head of the largest personal injury practice in Indiana, died at 85 years old on Christmas Eve, leaving behind his son, daughter, and two grandchildren.

item.title: Kountry Kitchen’s 17th annual Christmas Giveback feeds thousands of families
item.description: INDIANAPOLIS (WISH) — For nearly two decades, one Indianapolis restaurant has made it its mission to ensure no family goes without a hot meal on Christmas Day. item.title: 6 hospitalized, pets killed in Christmas morning fire on Indy’s southeast side
item.description: Six people were hospitalized and a dog died after a Christmas morning fire on Indy's southeast side, with the cause of the fire still unknown.
